A confused character’s actions are determined by rolling percentage at the beginning of his turn: 01–25 act normally, 26–50 do nothing but babble incoherently, 51–75 deal 1d8 points of damage + Str modifier to self with item in hand, 76–100 attack nearest creature (for this purpose, a familiar counts as part of the subject’s self). A confused character that can’t carry out the indicated action does nothing but babble incoherently. Attackers are not at any special advantage when attacking a confused character. Any confused character that is attacked automatically attacks its attackers on its next turn, as long as it is still confused when its turn comes. A confused character does not make attacks of opportunity against any creature that is not already devoted to attacking (either because of its recent action or because it has just been attacked).

entries.name: Dexterous Etude III
entries.description: You play a song of agility, enhancing nearby allies’ Dexterity to great effect. Each round this song is in effect, the targets gain a +6 morale bonus to Dexterity.

entries.name: Enchanting Etude III
entries.description: You play a song of wit and charm, enhancing nearby allies’ Charisma to great effect. Each round this song is in effect, the targets gain a +6 morale bonus to Charisma.

entries.name: Foe Discord II
entries.description: You play a song of destruction, damaging those within 30 feet with non-elemental damage. Each round this song is in effect, enemies within 30 feet of you suffer double your Charisma modifier points of non-elemental damage. You may only have 1 Foe Requiem/Discord song in effect.

entries.name: Fowl Aubade III
entries.description: You play an energetic song of wakefulness, boosting your allies’ resistance to sleep and charm spells and effects. Each round this song is in effect, allies within 30 feet of the bard gain a +9 morale bonus on saving throws against sleep and charm spells and effects.

entries.name: Goblin Gavotte III
entries.description: You play a rousing song of freedom, boosting your allies’ resistance to paralysis and petrify effects. Each round this song is in effect, allies within 30 feet of the bard gain a +9 morale bonus on saving throws against the Paralyzed, Petrification and Statue status effects.

entries.name: Goddess's Hymnus
entries.description:
You play a divine hymn venerating your cause. Allied creatures within 30 feet of you gain the [Reraise](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/status-effects/#reraise) status effect. Once one ally has been revived by this effect the song ends. The reraise status also applies to you, though all bard songs and performances expire when you fall unconscious as normal.

*This spell was submitted as a part of the SCC for January 2021 by MagnusXL.*

entries.name: Grand Finale
entries.description: With the grandest of flourishes, you can immediately end all 1st level or higher songs you are currently maintaining to a wider area while prolonging its effects. The range of all the songs that you have ended as part of Grand Finale are doubled, and their effects persist for a duration equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier without you having to maintain them. Song effects on creatures behave as if they are continually within the song’s range (ex: forcing a save on a creature for every round until they fail or the song duration ends).

entries.name: Herb Pastoral III
entries.description: You play a song of cleansing, boosting your allies’ resistance to disease and poison spells and effects. Each round this song is in effect, allies within 30 feet of the bard gain a +9 morale bonus on saving throws against disease and poison spells and effects.

entries.name: Hero's Rime
entries.description: You play a song echoing the heroes of eld, channeling their power into nearby allies. Each round this song is in effect, allies within 30 feet of the bard gain a +2 morale bonus to each ability score.

entries.name: Hunter’s Prelude III
entries.description: You play the song of the hunter, granting allies a bonus to ranged weapon attack rolls. Each round this song is in effect, allies within 30 feet of the bard gain a +6 morale bonus to ranged weapon attack rolls.

entries.name: Learned Etude III
entries.description: You play a song of knowledge, enhancing nearby allies’ Intelligence to great effect. Each round this song is in effect, the targets gain a +6 morale bonus to Intelligence.

entries.name: Romeo's Ballad II
entries.description:
You perform a romantic song, causing an enemy to be stopped in its tracks. Each round this song is in effect, an enemy within 30 feet of the bard suffers the [Stop](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/status-effects/#stop) status effect. 

Stop: The victim is unable to move and act (is helpless) for the duration of the spell or until cured.

entries.name: Scop’s Operetta III
entries.description: You play a song of sight and sound, boosting your allies’ resistance to silence/blind spells and effects. Each round this song is in effect, allies within 30 feet of the bard gain a +9 morale bonus on saving throws against silence and blind spells and effects.

entries.name: Sinewy Etude III
entries.description: You play a song of might, enhancing nearby allies’ Strength to great effect. Each round this song is in effect, the targets gain a +6 morale bonus to Strength.

entries.name: Spirited Etude III
entries.description: You play a song of might, enhancing nearby allies’ Wisdom to great effect. Each round this song is in effect, the targets gain a +6 morale bonus to Wisdom.

entries.name: Sword Madrigal III
entries.description: You play the song of precision, granting allies a bonus to melee weapon attack rolls. Each round this song is in effect, allies within 30 feet of the bard gain a +6 morale bonus to Attack rolls with melee weapons.

entries.name: Valor Minuet III
entries.description: You play the song of valor, granting allies a bonus to weapon damage rolls. Each round this song is in effect, allies within 30 feet of the bard gain a +6 morale bonus to weapon damage rolls.

entries.name: Vivacious Etude III
entries.description: You play a song of fortitude, enhancing nearby allies’ Constitution to great effect. Each round this song is in effect, the targets gain a +6 morale bonus to Constitution.
